title: CUSU DDR4 32GB (2x16GB) 3200MHz CL16 RAM US$148 (~A$211.07) with PayPal Delivered @ CUSU Official Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: CUSU DDR4 32GB (2x16GB) 3200MHz CL16 RAM US$148 (~A$211.07) with PayPal Delivered @ CUSU Official Store AliExpress

[Robbo89] It's a 3600mhz kit according to the description, weird how they advertise it as the 3200mhz cl 16 profile.
[Clear] There's multiple products on the same listing.
[Robbo89] Still weird to not be the 3600mhz one as the headliner
[AdModnar] … the idea that this is all our fault, because regular people are buying RAM….
[Brick50] tempted to buy another 32gb until I realised if it was pre AI pricing I wouldn't have even batted an eyelid at a ram deal since I don't need anymore
[Merlict] I only have 16 so could do with a topup.
[Doughy Dave] Peasants!! How dare you! You'll own nothing and you'll like it!
[Whiplash] anyone know how good the service is if there's a fault? I've had brand names (corsair) fail ram86 burn-ins.
[xrailgun] essentially, expect no service outside the initial ~30 day or so return/dispute window, unless you happen to be visiting china and can post things very cheaply.
[xrailgun] If I want to get 2 kits (2x2x16GB) - would I be better off doing 2 separate transactions? or lump them together?
cashback caps at $50, but paypal is 1 redemption per account.
2 separate transactions through 2 separate accounts?
[Clear] Two separate orders is best with a second account.
[xrailgun] do you know if the "one use per account" is per aliexpress account or per paypal account? or both?
[ps3_andy] I don't know what I did but my order was $143.00USD for the 3200mhz 32gb option, so I paid $203.94AUD with my card, and then got $50AUD cashback with topcashback, as well as $3.57USD credit from team Ozbargain. Thanks @Clear I'd been eyeing a 32gb kit for a few months now waiting for a good price.
[markathome] Might get downvoted but…
One year and three months ago, a standard 32GB DDR5 RAM kit typically cost around $90 to $120 USD. source
This sucks - I need to buy RAM too. But these prices are insanity especially for previous generation stuff (DDR4).
